description: Transfer failure — medium priority, direct reply expected
message: I tried to send money to my friend yesterday but the transfer failed. The money was deducted from my account but my friend didn't receive it. Can you help me?

description: Card not received — medium priority, direct reply expected
message: I applied for a new debit card two weeks ago but I still haven't received it. Can you check the status of my card delivery?

description: Blocked account — high priority, should escalate
message: My account has been blocked and I cannot access my funds. I need this resolved urgently as I have bills to pay. Please help immediately!

description: Refund request — medium priority, direct reply expected
message: I was charged twice for the same transaction at a restaurant last Friday. I need a refund for the duplicate charge of $45.50.

description: Lost card — high priority, should escalate
message: I lost my card yesterday and I'm worried someone might use it. I need to block it right away and get a replacement.

description: Top-up failed — medium priority, might ask for more info
message: I tried to top up my account using a card but it failed, what should I do?

description: Exchange rate inquiry — low priority, direct reply expected
message: What is the current exchange rate for USD to EUR? I'm planning to make an international transfer.

description: Suspicious transaction — high priority, should escalate
message: I just noticed several transactions on my account that I did not make. Someone might have stolen my card information. This is an emergency!
